connector.name: Designvault
connector.registryDescription: Search, browse and manage your DesignVault design-asset library from any MCP client.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package designvault-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace net.designvault. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DESIGNVAULT_API_KEY
env.description: Per-organization DesignVault API key (dv_live_…). Generate one under Settings → API keys.

env.name: DESIGNVAULT_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL (defaults to https://www.designvault.net). Point at a preview deployment or http://localhost:3000 during development.

env.name: DESIGNVAULT_ENABLE_WRITE
env.description: Set to 1/true to register the write tools (create, update, delete). Off by default so a shared key cannot mutate data without explicit opt-in.
